# Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Separately, satellite data tracked bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025.

That footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories. The record refers to the share of reef area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress—not to the share of reefs verified as having bleached or died.
